summary: No operator page exists: the city has no website of its own, and the chamber's community page lists Brooks Memorial Park among the city parks without mentioning camping. The only camping sources are third-party: The Dyrt (walk-in tent sites, one 2022 review warning off large trailers) and AllStays (free, 4 tent sites). Nothing current confirms RV camping, the 15-amp shelter sites or the gravel lot. Weak entry: phone ask or drop candidate.

The stored note's two 15-amp shelter sites and gravel lot came from Campendium, which refuses automated reads and was not re-read. Imagery shows a small dirt lot on the park's south edge at ~43.1763,-101.7300 next to shelters and trees, consistent with the old note but not proof of RV camping. A call to the City of Martin (605) 685-6525 would settle whether RVs may stay overnight and whether electric is available.
